name: lever
title: Lever bench: optimised lever
description: Lever C (and D, the variant both): the stiffest layout of the same mass that rulecad's optimiser finds for the bench's load (problems/lever.json), and for D, for an angled load too. Variant milled (E): C's problem with its profile milled through a plate by a 4 mm end mill, no window narrower than the tool and every inside corner rounded to its radius.
orientation: Flat on the bed. 100% infill (or walls enough to be solid), 0.2 mm layers, the same filament as the other specimens. Variant milled can be milled from a 6 mm plate instead: its profile is cut through by a 4 mm end mill along z, the bolt holes drilled.

problem.rule: The optimisation problem: the bench's load, or (lever:both) an angled one too, or (lever:milled) the bench's load with the profile milled through a plate

target.rule: Every specimen's volume: the same share of the envelope
target.label: Volume
